summary: Scienjoy Holding Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing its audited financial results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, along with a press release summarizing operating and financial highlights. The filing reports a net loss of RMB595.0 million, driven by non-cash impairment charges, but does not announce any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, or forced management change. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms to report.
